about: Law keys the automatic pinning commands (fetch_batch5.py laws / missing, and every batch fetcher built on it) never pin: each was pinned once from a note link, and headyear.py showed that the page at the link is a different act. `gap <id> <url>` still pins a key on purpose.

keys.law:mp-144-2003: the linked pages (MPV/144.htm, MPV/Antigas_2003/144.htm) are Lei 9.427/1996, not MP 144/2003 (removed in parts zzv and zzw)
keys.law:mp-181-2004: the linked page (_Ato2004-2006/2004/Mpv/181.htm) is Lei 10.438/2002, not MP 181/2004 (removed in part zzw)
keys.law:dl-900-1968: misprinted key: the linked page is Decreto-Lei 900 of 29.9.1969 (removed in part zzm after the NOTE_FIX)
keys.law:mp-246-1997: misprinted key: Lei 9.491's note reads 'Medida Provisória nº 246, de 1997'; the linked page is Medida Provisória 246 of 6.4.2005 (pinned as law:mp-246-2005; removed in part zzzc)
keys.law:lei-12963-2012: Lei 9.636 note misprint ('Lei nº 12.963, de 2012'); the linked page is Lei 12.693/2012 (removed in the thirtieth session)
keys.law:mp-152-2003: the linked page (MPV/Antigas_2003/152.htm) is Lei 9.636/1998, not Medida Provisória 152/2003 (removed in the thirtieth session)
keys.law:lei-6306-1978: misprinted key: Decreto-Lei 3.365's note reads 'Lei nº 6.306, de 1978'; the linked page is Lei 6.306 of 15.12.1975 (pinned as law:lei-6306-1975; removed in the thirtieth session)
keys.law:dl-1648-1977: misprinted key: Decreto-Lei 1.598 art. 10's 'Vide Decreto-lei nº 1.648, de 1977' links Del1648.htm, Decreto-Lei 1.648 of 18.12.1978 (removed in part zzzx)
keys.law:lei-13241-1941: misprinted key: Lei 11.196 art. 30's note reads 'Lei nº 13.241, de 1941'; the linked page is Lei 13.241 of 30.12.2015, pinned as law:lei-13241-2015 (removed in part zzzy; the note is fixed by NOTE_FIX)
keys.law:lei-12876-2013: Lei 9.615's header note 'Vide Lei nº 12.876, de 2013' links L12867.htm, Lei 12.867/2013's page, not Lei 12.876 (a 'Vide' pin only, credited nowhere; listed in the forty-ninth session)
keys.law:mp-39-2002: the linked page's first heading is Lei 9.615/1998, the act it amends, not Medida Provisória 39/2002 (a 'Vide' pin only, credited nowhere; listed in the forty-ninth session)
